_note: The registry of Research tools: one place for the rail drawer, the feature keys, the pages and their server tiers. scripts/check-research-tools.mjs compares it with partials/faith-received/_tfr-rail.hbs, assets/js/feature-gate.js, the page templates and the Research page index. scripts/check-research-gate.mjs loads each url in a signed-out Chrome. Server tiers: 'member' = a worker route refuses a caller with no member token (website/workers/scripts/check-tfr-tier.mjs); 'client-only' = the data is public static JSON in R2 that open surfaces (reader, Scripture, Topics) read too, so only the page and the click are gated.

tools.name: Ask
tools.what: A question answered from the library, with the pages it drew on.

tools.name: Power Search
tools.what: Search by meaning rather than by word, across every collection.

tools.name: Compare
tools.what: Two to four authors on one topic, side by side.

tools.name: Connections
tools.what: The library mapped by citation: who reads whom.

tools.name: Commentary Decks
tools.what: A commented text place by place, with its commentators beside it.

tools.name: Disputed Questions
tools.what: The questions the schools argued, with each author's answer.

tools.name: Lexicon
tools.what: Every term in the library, as its authors define it.

tools.name: Set Indexes
tools.what: One index for a whole set of volumes.

tools.name: Page Scans
tools.what: Works you can read beside the printed page they came from.

tools.name: Bookmarks
tools.what: The works you have saved, and where you stopped in each.

tools.name: Notebook
tools.what: Passages you have kept, with your notes and collections.

tools.name: Desk
tools.what: Write with your saved sources beside you, each linked to its text.
